page.layout: One blank page of paper. No text blocks, no margins with text, no running head or page number.
page.notes: Blank page. Faint blue-grey lines in the lower half are show-through from the reverse side and are not transcribed. Aged paper stains and a small dark mark near the lower edge are not printed matter. A faint mark near the bottom centre could be a stain or a gathering mark; it is too unclear to record as a signature. Dark scanner edges at the top, right and left are not part of the page.
